Step into the ultimate musical time machine with Greatest Hits Radio! We proudly bring you a curated collection of the best hits spanning over 100 years of music history, offering a rich tapestry of songs that have defined generations. From the swinging tunes of the 1920s to today’s unforgettable anthems, we cover every iconic moment in music, decade by decade. Whether you’re reliving childhood memories through beloved favorites or rediscovering forgotten classics, our station brings you the biggest hits across 11 decades, capturing the unique sounds and trends that have shaped the musical landscape.

Discover a World of Musical Genres and Styles

At Greatest Hits Radio, we understand that everyone’s taste in music is unique, which is why we’ve created special mix stations catering to various styles and genres. Each station offers an immersive experience tailored to your musical passions:

Disco Hits: Feel the thrill of the dance floor and let loose under the shimmer of a glitterball with our Disco Hits station. Get ready to move to timeless beats and relive the golden age of disco with tracks that make you want to dance all night long.

Country Classics: Dust off your cowboy boots and tune in to the best of Country music! Featuring the greatest names and songs in country, our station transports you to the heart of Americana, capturing stories of love, life, and the open road.

Motown Soul: Groove to the soulful rhythms of Motown with the unforgettable voices and melodies that sparked a revolution in music. From The Supremes to Marvin Gaye, experience the music that defined an era of powerful sound and meaningful lyrics.

Soft Rock Favourites: If you’re in the mood for guitar solos and heartfelt lyrics, our Soft Rock station delivers all the hits that make you want to grab an air guitar and sing along. Whether it’s mellow ballads or upbeat rock tunes, this station celebrates the softer side of rock music.

Your Go-To Destination for Iconic Hits

Greatest Hits Radio is more than just a radio station; it’s a place where music lovers from all walks of life can come together to celebrate the tracks that have left an indelible mark on music history. From chart-topping singles to underrated gems, we’ve gathered the very best hits in one place, ensuring there’s something for every listener, no matter their age or musical background. Whether you’re here to reminisce or explore, our library offers a unique blend of nostalgia and discovery.

Listen Anytime, Anywhere – Totally Free and Ad-Free!

Greatest Hits Radio is your free, ad-free gateway to an endless array of musical classics. Our user-friendly online streaming platform lets you enjoy timeless tunes wherever you are, whenever you want. Share the experience with friends and family, and make Greatest Hits Radio your go-to destination for high-quality music enjoyment. Whether you’re looking to revisit the golden years of music or discover something new, Greatest Hits Radio brings you an unparalleled listening experience that connects you with the very best in music history.

Welcome to Country, the ultimate hub for fans who live and breathe country music! Whether you're drawn to the soulful ballads of classic legends or the upbeat tunes of today’s top stars, we’ve crafted a place where every country music lover can feel at home. With over 100 radio stations, Country Music Radio offers free, easy access to an endless variety of country music, bringing together all the hits, hidden gems, and timeless classics.

Experience the Full Spectrum of Country Music

Country music is as vast as it is diverse, covering decades of legendary sounds and emerging talents. We celebrate the full range of country music eras, from the honky-tonk heroes of the 1950s to the contemporary anthems of today’s chart-toppers. Our collection features stations dedicated to every decade, so you can experience the evolving sounds of country music or stick to the golden oldies.

For those who love the classics, enjoy artists like Hank Williams and Dolly Parton as they laid the groundwork for country’s iconic sound. Or, for fans of today’s big names like Luke Combs and Kacey Musgraves, tune into the latest tracks that are taking the genre by storm. Whatever your favourite era or artist, Country Music Radio is here to make it easy to find and enjoy the music you love.

Non-Stop Country, Free from Distractions

We believe that music should be experienced without interruption. That's why we’ve created a listening experience that’s completely ad-free and chat-free. When you tune in, it’s just you and the music, allowing you to get lost in the songs and stories that define country music. Whether you’re tuning in during a road trip, enjoying a relaxed evening, or setting the mood for a gathering, you can count on our uninterrupted service to deliver hours of country bliss.

Curated Playlists for Every Mood and Moment

Country music captures a wide range of emotions and stories, making it ideal for just about any occasion. Our expertly curated playlists cover everything from feel-good anthems to heartbreak ballads, letting you find the perfect soundtrack for your day. Dive into playlists that celebrate iconic storytellers, love songs, and foot-stomping party hits, or let us take you on a journey through country’s many moods and styles.

For fans of specific bands and artists, we’ve created stations dedicated to beloved groups like Alabama and the Zac Brown Band, as well as solo legends like Johnny Cash and Reba McEntire. And if you're in the mood for something fresh, our new artist playlists highlight emerging talent, giving you a taste of the next generation of country music stars.

Keep Your Boots Tappin' with Country Hits

Country is all about making sure you’ve got the right tunes to keep your spirits high. Our diverse station lineup ensures that every song selection is a hit, whether it’s a well-loved favourite or a catchy new release. With music that celebrates life’s highs, lows, and everything in between, you can always count on Country Music Radio to keep your boots tappin' and your heart singin'.

Join a Community of Country Music Lovers

Country music has a way of bringing people together, and we’re thrilled to foster a community where country music fans can celebrate and connect. Share your love for the genre with friends, discover new songs, and explore the vast world of country music all in one place. From country’s earliest pioneers to today’s trendsetters, every corner of country music finds a home here.

Let Country Music Radio Be Your Trusted Guide

Let the good times roll with Country, the ultimate source for all things country. Whether you're looking to reminisce with the sounds of yesteryear, discover new hits, or just unwind with the best of country music, we’re here to make every listening experience feel like home.

description:
YouPlay

Showcasing new music talent

Introducing YouPlay, a revolutionary platform from the fastest-growing radio platform, YouRadio. YouPlay is designed to liberate and empower artists with their very own radio station and showcase emerging talent to YouRadio listeners. Our goal is to make YouPlay a haven for talented up-and-coming artists, providing them with the freedom to showcase their unique sound and the control to shape their own musical journey while making a lasting impact on the music scene. YouPlay radio features a diverse range of artists across different genres, ensuring there's something new for every music lover.

The worldwide music industry appears to be solely focused on corporate revenue and shareholder value. Music companies are the stealth force driving the industry with a keen eye on profits rather than pure artistry. When you stream songs, an unacceptable percentage of the revenue goes directly to the record companies and multiple other parties. This financial model prioritises the interests of big corporations over those who create the content upon which they depend for their massive profits. In many cases, artists see only a fraction of the earnings from their work, with the majority being absorbed by their record labels. Furthermore, artists are often pressured to produce commercially viable material rather than exploring new or experimental sounds. This corporate need to generate consistent income leads to unadventurous, formulaic music where creativity takes a back seat to marketability.

The YouPlay business opportunity is ground-breaking for the music industry in that we provide a FREE platform, using the universally popular medium of radio, for artists to showcase their talent, control their careers and the option of monetisation to enable artists to generate their own revenue free from corporate interference.

If you’re an artist and would like your own YouPlay radio station, contact us today.
meta_description: Empowering new artists with YouPlay: Create your own radio station, showcase talent, and control your musical journey
name: YouPlay

description:
Noel Edmonds’ Billions Club

This is my Billions Club, featuring tracks that shaped decades, songs that shattered records, and legends that live forever.

Across the generations, a handful of truly iconic tracks have soared past one billion streams—a number that would have been unimaginable when I first started spinning records on BBC Radio 1 back in the day.

From Queen’s "Bohemian Rhapsody" to Fleetwood Mac’s "Dreams", to more recent anthems like Coldplay’s "Yellow", the music that defined each era still finds a way to unite new listeners and smash global records decades later.

For me, these milestones aren’t just about big numbers. They’re about timeless music, unforgettable moments, and the energy, escapism, and memories that only great music can deliver.

Decade after decade, the true anthems don’t fade—they just grow stronger. And now, with more than a billion streams behind them, they’ve officially earned their place in the history books.

I’m proud to celebrate these legends and invite you to join me in the Noel Edmonds’ Billions Club. Because when the music’s this good, there’s always room for more.
